state.policy: Decide-1 is coarse only. Do NOT pick a concrete tool name. Bands: tool_call = one deterministic tool act; spawn_subtasks = independent children; escalate_gen = free-form generation past frontier; ask_human = irreversible+low-conf or user-only ambiguity (D-ENG-030).

criteria.tool_call: A single deterministic tool action covers the request
criteria.spawn_subtasks: Independent subtasks should become child threads
criteria.escalate_gen: Needs generative drafting with a pre-targeted brief
criteria.ask_human: Ask the user before any consequential act

split_gain.instructions: If multi-part, would spawning children improve correctness/parallelism?

irreversible_low_conf.instructions: Is there an irreversible act with unresolved identity or low confidence?
